answer: Progressive task quotas stretch a forger's payback until bulk farming stops paying. A new identity starts with 2 task slots; each verified honest epoch adds 2 more, up to a cap of 40, and low-quota identities take only low-value work. A ferrous lock on quota growth means quotas never jump: buying an aged identity does not transfer its quota. The nectar of high-value tasks sits behind 20 honest epochs. A vault of 1,000 fresh identities earns less in a month than 50 established agents earn in a week. Forging 1,000 costs 100,000 to onboard, returning under 15,000 in 10 epochs.
